ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.name: Atlas Material
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.visual_thesis: An authoritative, contemporary digital cultural atlas rendered through disciplined Material 3 Expressive surfaces. Combines deep basalt canvases (#10141B) and warm sandstone containers (#1A202C) with high-density editorial typography, sharp hairline stone borders, and restrained tonal elevation.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.navigation_behavior: Edge-to-edge root NavigationBar (5 tabs: Explore, Map, Plan, Transit, You) with tonal pill indicators. On foldable unfolded / tablets (>=600dp), transitions smoothly to a left NavigationRail. Inner navigation powered by Jetpack Navigation 3 with predictive back gesture continuity.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.card_architecture: Structured tonal containers (Container Low / High) with 16dp rounded corners, 1.5dp subtle stone borders (#30363D), full-bleed 16:9 verified photography with scrimmed text protection, and discrete metadata footers.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.typography_hierarchy: Headline Large (Serif / Odia display, 28sp), Title Medium (20sp bold stone), Body Medium (15sp relaxed), Label Small (12sp tabular mono for departure times). Supports dynamic font scaling up to 2.0x without line clipping.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.map_relationship: Map as an analytical mode with Google Maps Compose. Standard basemap with custom JSON dark atlas styling. Cards dock cleanly at the bottom third as non-intrusive preview chips with elevation level 2.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.sheet_behavior: ModalBottomSheet with standard M3 snap points (peek 25%, expanded 85%). Smooth drag handle with spring damping. Respects system edge-to-edge insets and software keyboard IME padding.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.motion_principles: Material Shared Axis transitions (Z-axis for depth navigation, X-axis for tab switching) and Container Transform for card-to-detail expansion. Clamped duration (250–350ms) to ensure responsiveness on 60Hz displays.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.truth_badge_language: Integrated tonal chips in card header: [● Verified Official] (Emerald container), [◷ Scheduled · HH:MM] (Amber container), [☁ Live · 31°C] (Chilika container). High contrast text labels alongside discrete glyphs.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.offline_error_presentation: Persistent top status banner with subtle sandstone styling: 'Offline Atlas Active · Cached Content Available'. Retryable errors render an inline action button rather than blocking modal dialogs.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.active_trip_presentation: Clean vertical step timeline. Current stop elevated with active pulse indicator and walking feasibility chip (e.g. '800m · Walk Reasonable'). Emergency essentials accessible via floating pill button.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.one_hand_ergonomics: Primary interactive targets anchored within bottom 40% thumb zone. Fab / primary CTA aligned bottom-right with 48x48dp minimum touch target.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.adaptive_tablet_behavior: Two-pane List-Detail layout on expanded screens (Navigation 3 TwoPaneScene). Map occupies primary 60% canvas while place detail or route stops occupy secondary 40% supporting pane.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.low_end_gpu_feasibility: SAFE on Vivo Y19 / Helio P65. Zero real-time blur or custom shaders; relies exclusively on hardware-accelerated Compose Canvas and elevation shadows.
ANDROID_A_ATLAS_MATERIAL.accessibility_implications: Exceeds WCAG 2.2 AA. Fully compliant TalkBack reading order, touch targets >= 48dp, color-independent status icons, and robust focus restoration on sheet dismiss.

ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.name: Field Guide
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.visual_thesis: A rugged, travel-execution utility engineered for high mobility, field durability, and instant situational awareness. High-contrast monochrome base with vivid categorical accents (Terracotta, Forest Green, Chilika Blue), tight metadata grids, and zero decorative fluff.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.navigation_behavior: Compact edge-to-edge bottom bar with high-contrast glyphs and immediate state counters (e.g. 'Saved: 14'). Top action bar minimized to optimize vertical field viewport.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.card_architecture: Compact horizontal list cards (8dp corner radius) designed for rapid thumb skimming. Prominent status badges on the left edge, tabular distances on the right, and thumbnail inset.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.typography_hierarchy: Strict sans-serif and tabular mono hierarchy. Large tabular figures for distances ('1.4 km') and departure counts ('8 min'). High-contrast weights for extreme outdoor sunlight legibility.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.map_relationship: Persistent map canvas with high-density marker clustering. Floating bottom control strip allowing instantaneous toggling between Place Pins, Bus Stops, and Emergency Essentials.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.sheet_behavior: Compact non-modal bottom sheet (peek 180dp, max 60% height). Never covers the entire map so spatial context is perpetually visible while inspecting transit stops or destinations.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.motion_principles: Ultra-low-latency, utilitarian motion. Linear fades and swift vertical slides (< 150ms). Zero container morphs or heavy shared-element calculations. Instant response even during CPU throttling.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.truth_badge_language: Monochrome pill badges with clear text symbols: '[V] Official', '[S] Scheduled 08:30', '[E] Est 1.2km'. Designed for instant comprehension in bright glare.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.offline_error_presentation: Top-bar status pill: '[Airplane Mode: Local DB Active]'. Offline state is treated as a normal operating mode rather than an error or degraded condition.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.active_trip_presentation: Card-per-stop carousel anchored at screen bottom over the route polyline. Tapping 'Mark Visited' advances to next stop with immediate tactical haptic feedback.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.one_hand_ergonomics: Optimized for single-thumb transit grip. All core filters, search toggles, and navigation actions reside strictly within bottom 35% of the viewport.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.adaptive_tablet_behavior: Split timeline + map view. Itinerary schedule on the left rail, persistent interactive transit graph on the right.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.low_end_gpu_feasibility: SUPERIOR on Vivo Y19. Lowest memory footprint, zero complex clipping paths, instant cold boot rendering.
ANDROID_B_FIELD_GUIDE.accessibility_implications: Highest contrast ratios (6:1+ throughout). Excellent TalkBack ergonomics due to concise card semantics and logical sequential traversal.

ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.name: Living Odisha
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.visual_thesis: An expressive, culturally immersive journey celebrating Odisha living arts, temple architecture, and landscape. Incorporates handcrafted stone textures, warm terracotta backgrounds, editorial chapter markers, and rich cultural storytelling.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.navigation_behavior: Floating bottom navigation bar with soft rounded ends and terracotta indicator glow. Smooth page curls and chapter-like screen transitions.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.card_architecture: Expansive magazine-style cards with 24dp rounded corners, warm parchment headers (#FBF9F5 in light mode, #1C1917 in dark mode), artistic aspect ratios (4:3 and 1:1 craft showcases), and rich artisan pull-quotes.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.typography_hierarchy: Distinctive serif headlines inspired by stone inscriptions, paired with warm humanist body text. Extended line height (1.65) for relaxed long-form reading.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.map_relationship: Map styled with warm ochre and sandstone hues. Custom temple shikhar and craft pot pin icons. Map interacts through artistic translucent overlays.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.sheet_behavior: Full-bleed expressive modal sheets with top curved headers and integrated hero photo parallax.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.motion_principles: Fluid spring curves and expressive staggered entry animations. Visual elements cascade into view on initial load. Rich micro-interactions on bookmarking.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.truth_badge_language: Artisan seal-style badges: '[Temple Directorate Verified]', '[CRUT Official Timetable]'. Beautifully rendered with subtle borders and serif glyphs.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.offline_error_presentation: Warm illustrative empty states depicting Odisha heritage motifs (e.g. Konark wheel silhouette) with poetic offline guidance.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.active_trip_presentation: Story-driven travel log. Each completed destination unfolds a small cultural insight or folk tale associated with the monument or craft village.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.one_hand_ergonomics: Moderate. Top-anchored magazine headers require occasional two-handed reach; bottom actions provide core navigation.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.adaptive_tablet_behavior: Editorial multi-column magazine spread. Places presented as interactive editorial articles flanked by high-resolution cultural photo galleries.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.low_end_gpu_feasibility: MODERATE / RISKY on Vivo Y19. Staggered animations, large image surfaces, and parallax scroll increase frame drop risks on entry-level GPUs.
ANDROID_C_LIVING_ODISHA.accessibility_implications: Requires careful color auditing to ensure artistic terracotta and ochre accents maintain 4.5:1 contrast against dark canvases. Dynamic Type requires strict container bounds.

summary: Three genuinely distinct Android systems established: Atlas Material (balanced editorial M3), Field Guide (utilitarian transit & field execution), and Living Odisha (culturally expressive magazine). All grounded in real repository constraints.
